fact: The Council of Ministers record of 7 October 2025 lists, among the main challenges left after the ministry's digital-maturity diagnostic of the administration, the elaboration of a national digital strategy and sectoral roadmaps.

The government spokesperson's record of the fourth Council of Ministers session, chaired by President Guelleh, says the minister delegate for the digital economy gave a communication on the 'Djibouti Smart Nation: Feuille de Route pour l'Economie Numérique', built on four pillars (smart administration, digital economy, smart trades, smart civil society) with structuring projects identified; it records no adoption or approval, and the month is the document's published month (the session date is inferred, late March 2023).
